_comment: Suppressions for the BLOCKING dead-copy check in flow-xcheck.cjs (blocking since 2026-10-03; this comment said 'advisory, never blocks' until 2026-10-05 — it was stale). An unsuppressed finding BLOCKS the commit: it is a prompt to look, not an error to silence. Suppress here only when the text genuinely renders from outside app source. Adding an entry to silence the gate is how this file rots: each one must carry a reason that would still be true six months from now.

schema.match: Normalized (lowercased, whitespace-collapsed) equality against the assertion's cleaned literal — not a regex.
schema.reason: Why the text can render without appearing in app/ or i18n/locales/en.

entries.reason: Android runtime-permission dialog radio option (location/notifications). Rendered by the OS, not by this app, so it can never appear in app source or the locale files.
Barikoi/Nominatim geocoder result asserted after typing a destination. The text comes from a third-party API response, not from app copy.

truckCatalog labelEn of the marketplace truck-picker use-case tabs (asserted as ".*Freight.*|.*মালবাহী.*" in marketplace/v5-truck). The label renders from seed/catalog data (labelEn/labelBn), not from app source or the locale files.
truckCatalog labelBn — the Bengali alternate of the same Freight tab, asserted together with the EN label. Also seed/catalog data, not t() copy.

Expo dev-launcher screen during the DEV-BUILD LOAD HOP (auth/_login-rider, measured 2026-10-07): the native launcher renders the update's runtime version while resolving the dev bundle. Rendered by expo-dev-launcher, never by app source or locale files.
